summary: Jackson Hole delivered, and it was hawkish. Both index futures spiked to fresh highs right after the Warsh keynote, then reversed hard and gave it all back. NQ ran to 29,811 and closed 29,509, down 0.42%. ES tagged 7,782 and closed 7,724, essentially flat but well off the high. The real move was in gold: MGC cratered 3.25% to 4,468 as the 10-year yield jumped about 1.4%, a clean rates-up, gold-down reaction. Crude was the lone holdout, closing 83.43 and hanging onto its uptrend stop. Both index ATR stops flipped bearish today, so the two-day trend push is on hold.
psychology: Today is the classic event trap. The knee-jerk pop after a Fed headline pulls breakout buyers in at the highs, then the real move goes the other way and stops them out. If you chased 29,800 on NQ, you felt it. The lesson is not to predict the reaction, it is to wait for the reaction to resolve. A spike into an event is the lowest-quality entry there is. Let the first move exhaust, see where price accepts, and trade the level, not the headline. The ATR stop flipping bearish is information, not a reason to flip and short into the close either.

event.name: Jackson Hole keynote (Fed Chair Warsh)
event.consensus: Market positioned for policy continuity after two days of new highs
event.actual: The keynote read hawkish. Equities spiked to fresh highs in the opening hour (NQ 29,811, ES 7,782), then reversed sharply as the message sank in. The 10-year yield jumped about 1.4% to 4.729.
event.surprise: Hawkish surprise. Rates repriced higher, which hit gold hardest and trapped index longs at the highs.
event.nqReaction: Reflex pop to a 29,811.75 high, then a full reversal to close 29,509.5 (-0.42%), below AVWAP and NYVWAP, with the ATR stop flipping bearish.
event.crossAsset: Gold -3.25% (worst day of the run, most rate-sensitive), 10-year yield +1.4%, ES -0.10% (mirrored NQ), crude -0.11% (held, disconnected from rates). VIX near 14.4 and eased slightly on the post-event volatility bleed.

risk.sizing: Size down until direction confirms. The equity trend just reversed and both index stops flipped bearish on a high-volatility event day. This is a transition, not a clean new trend. Do not flip and chase shorts into the weekend at the lows either.
risk.openRisk: MNQ back above 29,706 or MES above 7,757 on two hourly closes neutralizes the fresh short bias. Gold reclaiming 4,536 is the first bounce signal after a 3.25% drop. Crude losing 82.41 on two closes flips the last long bearish too.
risk.note: Jackson Hole is largely behind the tape now; the hawkish read lifted yields and hit gold. Next macro is ISM manufacturing Tuesday Sep 1 and the August jobs report Friday Sep 4. Carry reduced posture over the weekend gap. Not financial advice.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html:
HTA OPEN (NY opening range, 13:30 to 13:45 UTC): OR high 29,701.25, OR low 29,562.5, width 138.75 points (0.47%). The open was a two-sided whipsaw. Price first closed below the OR low at 14:10 UTC (29,534.75), then reclaimed and broke the OR high at 14:40 UTC (29,734.25), ran to the 29,811.75 session high, then reversed and closed 29,509.5 back below the OR low. NYVWAP sat at 29,566 and price closed below it, so sellers had the close.

Signals: a failed upside break, so the read was distribution rather than continuation. HOF (short-only) had no clean hand-off in the chop, BIR did not fire on the 2-close rule, and MID had no clean first-hour rejection. For Monday, HOF, MID and BNC are eligible (BIR skips Monday); expect a gap-sensitive open, so keep the first break on a short leash.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long has its filter closed for the long side. NQ is below its flipped 29,706 ATR stop and below the 50-period trend reference after the reversal, so the regime filter no longer supports a fresh long. The intraday move was the opposite of a momentum-long setup: a failed breakout that reversed. A momentum filter turning off is doing its job, keeping you out of a long right when the trend rolled over.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band
fullReport.html:
AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,545, close 29,509 is about minus 0.4 sigma, inside the minus-1 band at 29,457. Normal range at the close. The real signal was intraday: the 29,811.75 high stretched beyond the plus-3 band (plus 3 sigma 29,808), a genuine exhaustion tag, and price mean-reverted hard back through the AVWAP. Bands: plus 3 sigma 29,808, plus 2 sigma 29,720, minus 2 sigma 29,369, minus 3 sigma 29,281. Sigma ran wide at 87.7 on the two-sided range. Volume unavailable on the continuous contract, so the exhaustion read is price-only.

The lesson: a plus-3 sigma tag into a known event is where reversion odds are highest. Today the band did its job.
